description: Source code for loading message catalogs, including file handling, memory mapping, charset conversion, and parsing of message catalog files (.mo files).

methods.name: _nl_init_domain_conv
methods.description: Initializes charset conversion for a loaded message catalog, determining charset and setting up conversion handle.

methods.name: _nl_free_domain_conv
methods.description: Frees resources associated with charset conversion for a domain.

methods.name: _nl_load_domain
methods.description: Loads a message catalog (.mo file), memory maps or reads it, verifies magic number, and initializes domain data structures.

methods.name: _nl_unload_domain
methods.description: Unloads a loaded message catalog, freeing resources and closing mappings.
